findings.issue: C2S compile closure could be conflated with implementation/runtime/deploy/device verification.

findings.issue: Machine schema did not express independent C2S/reflection/downstream axes.

findings.issue: Regression suite did not prove C2S closure with downstream/reflection still open or reject downstream conflation.

optimized_model.evidence_stream: Original/recoverable evidence and correction lineage remain preserved.
optimized_model.knowledge_projection: Atoms, relations, dispositions, owners and current canonical/project projections.
optimized_model.reflection_state: Whether required owner/canonical changes have actually been written and verified.
optimized_model.execution_track: Implementation, CI, runtime, deployment, device and external-integration realization.
optimized_model.reopen_rule: Reopen affected C2S scope only when new evidence exposes omission, false convergence, wrong disposition/ownership, broken correction lineage or unreconstructable intent.
